name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
a11y: Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The value of the item whose content is expanded when the accordion is initially rendered. Use
`defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of an accordion.
The value of the items whose contents are expanded when the accordion is initially rendered. Use
`defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of an accordion.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled stateful value of the accordion item whose content is expanded.
The controlled stateful value of the accordion items whose contents are expanded.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The callback that fires when the state of the accordion changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether or not an accordion is disabled from user interaction.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The layout in which the Accordion operates.

usage:
import {Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger} from '@monoline/react';

<Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="a">
  <AccordionItem value="a"><AccordionTrigger>What is Monoline?</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>A small UI kit: plain CSS plus accessible React components.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="b"><AccordionTrigger>Do I need React?</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>No. The CSS works on its own.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
